# kopia_current_user (Data Source)

Reports the operating-system user the Kopia server process runs as, and the host name of the machine — or container — it runs on. It works without a repository connected.

~> **This is neither the UI user the provider signs in as nor the identity the server takes snapshots as.** The latter is `username` and `hostname` of the `kopia_repository_status` data source, which a repository connection may override, and which then differ from these.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kopia_current_user" "this" {}

# The operating-system account and host the server process runs as. The
# identity the server takes snapshots as is reported by kopia_repository_status
# instead, and may differ.
output "kopia_server_process" {
  value = "${data.kopia_current_user.this.username}@${data.kopia_current_user.this.hostname}" # e.g. "root@kopia"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Host name of the machine running the server, lower-cased and cut at the first dot. In a container it is the container's host name. `nohost` when Kopia cannot look it up.
- `username` (String) Name of the operating-system account running the server, without a Windows domain: `root` for the official Docker image. `nobody` when Kopia cannot look it up.
